title: Making My Portfolio More Dynamic
summary: I improved my portfolio by making the header, footer and blog content load dynamically using JavaScript.
content: In this update I implemented reusable website components using JavaScript and fetch(). This reduced duplicated code which made the website more efficient

title: Adding a Theme Switcher
summary: I implemented a light and dark theme that saves the user's preference using localStorage.
content: The theme switcher changes the website appearance and theme and saves the selected theme using localStorage so that the preference remains even after refreshing or changing pages.

title: Designing My Portfolio Website and Navigation
summary: I completed the HTML and CSS base structure for my portfolio website, with proper navigation for all pages with a modern dark theme.
content: This stage focused on creating the layout, creating the navigation between pages, adding the CSS and designing pages for my about page, projects, resume, blog, and contact information.
